suites.description: Idea to completion follows the ordered Foundry stages

checks.name: every stage advances in order and records its evidence
illegal jumps and terminal re-entry are rejected
every transition requires evidence rather than assumed progress

suites.description: Agency execution requires the exact owner authorization reference

checks.name: execution cannot begin without an authorization reference
authorization is preserved through evidence and acceptance
acceptance cannot be reached without an evidence stage

suites.description: Steering invalidates only affected and dependent work

checks.name: changing one unit invalidates its dependents transitively
pause and resume preserve verified work without re-authorization
unverified work is never preserved as verified output
steering is deterministic and scoped to declared units

suites.description: Execution stays inside granted scope through steering

checks.name: affected work retains its declared authorization scope
steering cannot mark invalidated work as verified
